stem: Five independent room sensors rise together while the environmental-control dashboard reports an equipment fault. What is the strongest interpretation?
choices: All five sensors probably failed at exactly the same time
The pattern is more likely to represent a real room event and should be handled through the supplied response procedure
Only the lowest reading should be recorded
Sensor location no longer matters for any future reading
rationale: Agreement across multiple sensors plus equipment-status evidence supports treating the change as a likely real environmental event rather than a single-sensor anomaly.
